parameters.name: DeviceList
parameters.description:
The list of devices to validate in batches.

> You can specify up to 10,000 devices in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceName
sub_parameters.description:
The device name.

The device name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:), and must be 4 to 32 characters in length.

The device name must be unique within a product.

> You can specify up to 10,000 device names in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded.

sub_parameters.name: DeviceSecret
sub_parameters.description:
The device secret.

The device secret can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), at signs (@), periods (.), and colons (:), and must be 1 to 32 characters in length.

> You can specify up to 10,000 device secrets in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded.

sub_parameters.name: Sn
sub_parameters.description:
The serial number of the device.

The serial number can contain letters, digits, and underscores (_), and must be 1 to 64 characters in length.

> You can specify up to 10,000 device serial numbers in a single call. Data that exceeds this limit is discarded.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If this parameter is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If this parameter is unavailable, you do not need to specify it.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ProductKey
parameters.description: The **ProductKey** of the cloud gateway product to which the device belongs.
